caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figurine standing on a rectangular base. The figurine is painted in earth tones, primarily shades of beige, brown, and black. It represents a bearded man with a sharply pointed black hat, a pointed beard, and black hair. The face of the figurine is painted with a fair skin tone, dark eyebrows, and defined facial features; the lips have a hint of pink. The figure wears a long beige robe with black trim and geometric, crown-like motifs along the lower edge, layered over a black garment that covers the arms and legs. The robe has a lighter beige sash that drapes down the front. The arms are bent, and the hands are turned slightly upward, suggesting an open or welcoming gesture. The rectangular base is painted in a pale color with a black zigzag pattern along its front edge. There are several handwritten notes and a lightly sketched outline of another figure with a crown in the background. The composition is centered, with the majority of visual detail focused on the solitary figure. The rest of the page is mostly blank, with the notes and outlines drawn in pencil around the main image.
title: Bulto
